items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces canonical maps between a set and the stalk of its pushforward along a point of a topos, whose composite is the identity (statement lines 8386-8396). The proof is a short but complete argument: the adjunction supplies the map from the stalk to the set and it is an isomorphism on the final object because both functors are left exact (proof lines 8399-8402); the author then transports this isomorphism along the maps determined by the elements of the set to obtain the map in the other direction (proof lines 8402-8410), and the composite is the identity by construction. The non-formal content is the transport along the elements. The claim is H1: a short construction with the exactness input named.
